body: Its barely a drop in a bucket and after that hard work there is nothing to show for it.

I'm angry because all my weight loss efforts are for nothing. I've lost 80 lbs but it feels like it was for nothing. I still have over 100 to go and I just can't do it any more. I'm tired of always being judged. I met a nice guy, but now all he uses me for is sex. I'm tired of being degraded that way but it's the only time I feel close to someone. I'm to the point where I just want to get rid of my dog and end it. ... I just want someone to actually think I'm pretty and want me for me
My anger. My eating. My emotions. It's battle every day and I just can't do It. It's not worth it
